name: Lake Al'Ameth
summary: South of Dolanaar, Lake Al'Ameth's shores have turned perilous as the local plant life grows violent. Once a quiet haven with little more than a wooden jetty, the lake is one of Teldrassil's largest freshwater bodies.

sections.title: A Troubled Shoreline
sections.body: At Lake Al'Ameth, swarms of timberlings and timberling sprouts prowl the water's edge. The lake lies just south of Dolanaar, where its calm waters and sparse settlement offer little sign of the danger ashore. An unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil has driven the plant life into a frenzy. Druids and researchers from Dolanaar send travelers to gather seeds and kill the aggressive creatures before the corruption spreads deeper into the forest.

sections.title: The Roots of Wrath
sections.body: Oakenscowl, once a noble timberling, spreads corruption from a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. A gargantuan tumor has swollen his body, and other timberlings lash out at anyone who approaches. The woodland spirits have lost their balance, and the Cenarion Circle faces an urgent test: can the rot around the lake be diagnosed and treated, and can Teldrassil's unblessed creation be sustained?

faq.answer: Lake Al'Ameth lies directly south of Dolanaar, the night elf settlement in eastern Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are the creatures around Lake Al'Ameth hostile?
faq.answer: A corrupting sickness afflicts Teldrassil's timberlings and other plant life along the shore, driving previously harmless woodland spriggans and treants into a territorial rage.

faq.q: What structures or landmarks are on the lake?
faq.answer: The lake is largely wild and undeveloped. A simple wooden fishing jetty stands on its northern bank near the path from Dolanaar.

Oakenscowl is a corrupted timberling in a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. Once a grand leader among his kind, he is poisoned by a gargantuan tumor and spreads corruption to the creatures that call the lake home.

angles.text: As a kaldorei of Dolanaar, you see Lake Al'Ameth's sickness as a warning about the troubles facing your newly raised home. Young defenders must protect the surrounding road.
As a druid, you can study the unnatural corruption undermining Teldrassil's flora and fauna in the wild timberlings around the lake.
